title: Warner Bros. drops final trailer for Dune: Part Three
gist: Warner Bros. released its final trailer for Dune: Part Three, set 17 years after Part Two and adapted from Dune: Messiah, opening December 18, 2026 against Avengers: Doomsday.

insights.claim: Dune: Part Three opens December 18, 2026, going head to head with Avengers: Doomsday.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Direct competition for the holiday box office.

insights.claim: The film draws on Dune: Messiah and takes place roughly 17 years after Part Two, with a conspiracy and assassination plot involving Chani.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Darker final installment of the trilogy.
insights.locator: Paragraph beginning "Dune: Part Three draws on"

insights.claim: Returning stars include Timothee Chalamet, Zendaya, Florence Pugh and Rebecca Ferguson, with newcomers Anya Taylor-Joy and Robert Pattinson.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
